Radiology Division, UMCG Groningen — 10 February 2025 | Modality: Prostate mpMRI

Clinical context involves reassessment due to a sustained upward trajectory in serum PSA (34.7 ng/mL) alongside a previously unrevealing biopsy.

FINDINGS:
Glandular architecture measures 99.5 mL overall, exhibiting asymmetric hypertrophy. T2-weighted sequences highlight a sharply demarcated hypointense area in the right mid-gland peripheral zone, spanning roughly 14 × 11 × 10 mm. DWI shows pronounced diffusion restriction with correspondingly depressed ADC metrics. DCE sequences capture early, focal contrast uptake within that identical zone. Seminal vesicles maintain bilateral integrity. Capsular margins remain intact without extracapsular spread, vesicular invasion, or suspicious nodal enlargement. Bladder neck and urethral canal appear normal.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 4 lesion in the right mid-gland peripheral zone. PSAD 0.352 ng/mL/mL. csPCa predicted probability 0.739.

previous_notes.text: Serum PSA levels have held steady at 29.5 ng/mL subsequent to the Negative systematic sampling conducted earlier this year. General health remains stable, with osteoarthritis symptoms adequately controlled via paracetamol as required.
